idea: Reverse-engineer installed Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code agent flows to derive best practices for planner-researcher-helper communication, instructions, skills, and parallelism

claims.claim: All three use bounded fresh-context delegation, scoped instructions/skills, structured lifecycle hooks, and explicit coordination rather than shared hidden context.
The dominant opportunity is context/tool/instruction narrowing plus executable budget/deadline policy, not adding more parallelism.
Do not redesign planner/helper contracts; keep typed handoffs and locked lanes, but make route selection shrink the researcher prompt/tool surface and enforce per-stage budgets.
